body.en:
Classification:

  • House drain collects wastewater from a building; lateral and branch sewers convey it to larger trunk or interceptor sewers.
  • Sanitary sewers carry sewage, storm drains carry rainfall runoff, and combined sewers carry both where the system is designed for it.
  • Gravity sewers normally flow partially full; rising mains convey pumped wastewater under pressure.

Sections: circular pipes are economical and structurally efficient; egg-shaped sections may maintain better low-flow depth in some combined systems; rectangular or other sections serve special large flows. Choose according to hydraulics, structural load, maintenance and cost. Common joints include flexible gasketed socket joints, concrete collars and welded/fused plastic joints as appropriate; watertightness and flexibility matter.
body.gu:
Classification:

  • House drain building નું wastewater એકત્ર કરે છે; lateral અને branch sewers તેને મોટા trunk અથવા interceptor sewers સુધી લઈ જાય છે.
  • Sanitary sewers sewage, storm drains rainfall runoff અને combined sewers design મુજબ બંને વહન કરે છે.
  • Gravity sewers સામાન્ય રીતે partially full વહે છે; rising mains pumped wastewater pressure હેઠળ વહન કરે છે.

Sections: Circular pipes આર્થિક અને structurally કાર્યક્ષમ છે; egg-shaped sections અમુક combined systems માં low-flow depth જાળવી શકે; rectangular અથવા અન્ય sections ખાસ મોટા flows માટે છે. Hydraulics, structural load, maintenance અને cost પ્રમાણે પસંદ કરો. યોગ્ય flexible gasketed socket, concrete collar અને welded/fused plastic joints સામાન્ય છે; watertightness અને flexibility મહત્વનાં છે.

body.en:
Appurtenances and locations:

  • Manhole: access for inspection and mechanised cleaning at junctions, changes in alignment, gradient or diameter, and suitable intervals; provide a secure cover and flow channel.
  • Drop manhole: accommodates a substantial difference between inlet and outlet levels using an appropriately designed drop connection.
  • Flushing tank: provides a controlled flush at suitable upper ends where flow is insufficient to remove deposits, when the selected system requires it.
  • Catch basin: collects storm runoff and traps some grit/debris; routine cleaning is necessary and its outflow must go to the correct drainage system.
  • Inverted siphons, ventilating arrangements and pumping stations serve special alignment or hydraulic needs.

Manholes are hazardous confined spaces. Inspection access does not imply permission to enter; use remote inspection and approved safety procedures.
body.gu:
Appurtenances અને locations:

  • Manhole: junctions, alignment, gradient અથવા diameter ના ફેરફારો અને યોગ્ય intervals પર inspection તથા mechanised cleaning માટે access; secure cover અને flow channel આપો.
  • Drop manhole: inlet અને outlet levels માં મોટો તફાવત યોગ્ય designed drop connection વડે સંભાળે છે.
  • Flushing tank: પસંદ કરેલી system માં જરૂર હોય ત્યારે ઓછા flow ને કારણે deposits દૂર કરવા યોગ્ય upper ends પર controlled flush આપે છે.
  • Catch basin: storm runoff એકત્ર કરે અને થોડું grit/debris રોકે છે; નિયમિત cleaning જરૂરી છે અને outflow યોગ્ય drainage system માં જવો જોઈએ.
  • Inverted siphons, ventilating arrangements અને pumping stations ખાસ alignment અથવા hydraulic જરૂરિયાતો પૂરી કરે છે.

Manholes જોખમી confined spaces છે. Inspection access એટલે અંદર પ્રવેશની મંજૂરી નથી; remote inspection અને approved safety procedures વાપરો.

body.en:
Laying sequence:

  1. Survey alignment, invert levels, existing utilities and the required gradient; set out manholes.
  2. Excavate with safe trench support; dewater if designed and prepare the specified bedding.
  3. Lay pipes to line and gradient, usually working from downstream toward upstream with sockets oriented according to the specified jointing practice. Keep the interior clean and joints watertight.
  4. Construct chambers and benching; check levels, jointing and connections, then backfill and compact as specified.
  5. Test sections for leakage using the approved water or air test, test head, duration and acceptance criteria in the applicable standard and contract. Record the result and repair failures.

Hydraulic test pressure is not the same as operating pressure for every pipe. Never invent a universal test head or acceptance limit; use the current pipe specification and authority requirements.
body.gu:
Laying sequence:

  1. Alignment, invert levels, existing utilities અને જરૂરી gradient survey કરો; manholes નું setting out કરો.
  2. સલામત trench support સાથે excavation કરો; design મુજબ dewatering કરો અને નિર્દિષ્ટ bedding તૈયાર કરો.
  3. Pipes ને line અને gradient પર સામાન્ય રીતે downstream થી upstream તરફ નાખો, sockets ની દિશા નિર્દિષ્ટ jointing practice મુજબ રાખો. અંદરનો ભાગ સ્વચ્છ અને joints watertight રાખો.
  4. Chambers અને benching બનાવો; levels, jointing અને connections તપાસો, પછી નિર્દેશ મુજબ backfill અને compact કરો.
  5. લાગુ standard અને contract મુજબ approved water અથવા air test, test head, duration અને acceptance criteria થી sections ની leakage તપાસો. Result નોંધો અને failures repair કરો.

દરેક pipe માટે hydraulic test pressure અને operating pressure સમાન નથી. Universal test head અથવા acceptance limit મનથી ન લો; current pipe specification અને authority requirements વાપરો.

body.en:
Routine work: map and inspect the network, remove deposits with jetting or mechanical equipment, clear roots where authorised, check structural defects using CCTV, prevent illegal connections and document repairs. Investigate repeated blockages and odour rather than treating symptoms alone.

Safety: prevent public access, use traffic controls and trained operators, and prefer remote mechanised methods. Sewers can contain toxic hydrogen sulphide, flammable gases and oxygen-deficient atmospheres. Hazardous manual cleaning is prohibited. Never enter or attempt rescue without the legally required confined-space system, trained rescue team and appropriate equipment.
body.gu:
નિયમિત કાર્ય: Network mapping અને inspection કરો, jetting અથવા mechanical equipment થી deposits દૂર કરો, મંજૂર હોય ત્યાં roots દૂર કરો, CCTV થી structural defects તપાસો, illegal connections અટકાવો અને repairs નોંધો. વારંવાર blockages અને odour ના મૂળ કારણો તપાસો.

Safety: Public access અટકાવો, traffic controls અને trained operators વાપરો અને remote mechanised methods ને પ્રાથમિકતા આપો. Sewers માં ઝેરી hydrogen sulphide, flammable gases અને oxygen-deficient atmosphere હોઈ શકે છે. Hazardous manual cleaning પ્રતિબંધિત છે. કાયદાકીય confined-space system, trained rescue team અને યોગ્ય equipment વગર કદી પ્રવેશ અથવા rescue નો પ્રયત્ન ન કરો.

title.en: Numerical 7.1 — Sewer gradient and invert fall
title.gu: Numerical 7.1 — Sewer gradient અને invert fall

body.en:
Given: A sewer is 120 m long at a uniform gradient of 1 in 200. If the upstream invert level is 50.000 m, find the downstream invert.

Step 1. Calculate fall.

Fall = length / 200Fall = 120 / 200Fall = 0.600 m

Step 2. Subtract from upstream invert.

Downstream invert = 50.000 − 0.600

Final answer:

Downstream invert = 49.400 m.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Sewer 120 m લાંબો છે અને તેનો uniform gradient 1 in 200 છે. Upstream invert level 50.000 m હોય તો downstream invert શોધો.

Step 1. Fall ગણો.

Fall = length / 200Fall = 120 / 200Fall = 0.600 m

Step 2. Upstream invert માંથી બાદ કરો.

Downstream invert = 50.000 − 0.600

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Downstream invert = 49.400 m.
